BRACE 2/6

Pause
Normal
PRIMARY
Lats
SECONDARY
Rhomboids, Rear Delts, Biceps, Core

Instructions

Preparation: Set up with torso parallel to the floor, bar on the ground over midfoot. Grip just outside your knees, back flat, core braced hard.

1

Brace flat-backed with the bar over midfoot.

2

Keep your torso low and feet planted.

3

Row the bar toward your lower chest.

4

Draw elbows back; squeeze your shoulder blades.

5

Lower under control to a dead stop.

6

Keep feet planted; brace before each row.

Watch out

The dead stop only works if the torso stays parallel. If your back rounds at the bottom, the weight's too heavy — this movement punishes sloppy form fast.
